# AI Technical Daily

## Runtime Reliability

Agent framework release notes add durable execution and benchmark harness support for long-running agent workflows. This matters for production reliability. [Framework Release Notes](https://example.test/agent-runtime)

## Realtime Interfaces

An official release adds a realtime speech model for interactive applications, which may help lower-latency product interfaces. [Official Blog](https://example.test/realtime-model)
